author: GoPro
description:
Meet the @ASUS ProArt GoPro Edition laptop 💻 This powerful new machine enables everyone to be the hero of their own story—combining the worlds of capturing + creating content by seamlessly integrating GoPro's DNA with ASUS's legendary computing power.

✔️ GoPro-Inspired Rugged Build with CNC-engraved black metal finish + Military-Grade MIL-STD-810H durability
✔️ Weighs just 3 pounds (1.39 kg)—easy to carry for on-location editing, shoots, or frequent travel.
✔️ All-day power provided by a 73 WHr battery
✔️ Dedicated GoPro Hotkey that launches GoPro Player for streamlined access to content
✔️ Blazing Fast AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 Processor—perfect for 4K/8K editing workflows
✔️ 28 GB LPDDR5X Unified Memory for ultra-responsive multitasking
✔️ 1 TB (or optional 2 TB) NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD that enables lightning-fast project loading + export speeds
✔️ AI-powered StoryCube integration—automated smart-sorting of clips
✔️ Stunning 13.3″ 3K OLED touchscreen with true-to-life, 100% DCI-P3 + Pantone
title: Introducing the ASUS ProArt GoPro Edition Laptop
